description: Parkering för rörelsehindrade is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Tomelilla kommun. Parking spaces for people with reduced mobility show parking spaces intended for people with disabilities. In these parking spaces a special parking permit is required. Coverage: Tomelilla kommun. The portal shows the English title as "Parking for the disabled" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Tomelilla kommun. Its keywords include Parkering, Rörelsehindrad, Parkeringsplats, Tillgänglighet, Trafik. The listing shows 3 download or service links in JSON, CSV, XLSX. The listing shows 2021-05-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
